relations: As she turns, the fan sweeps from low-right outward into horizontal extension, its silk spreading open.
When the fan lifts overhead, the cyan edge drapes downward while her reflection mirrors the motion.
As her raised arm lowers, the fan descends at her right and the blue panel sweeps toward her left.
When she steps wider, the fan rests low at her side with both arms extended outward.
caption: The video captures a female dancer in a mirrored studio, seen from behind at center-right, in a white strapless top, blue-hemmed trousers, a long dark braid. She holds a large folding fan whose silk fades from white at the spine to bright cyan at the edge, her reflection tracking her in the left mirror. The fan is held low to her right with one arm raised, then sweeps outward into a horizontal extension as she turns. Its silk spreads open and lifts overhead, the blue edge draping downward while she rotates toward the mirror. The fan moves to a raised position at her right, held out with the blue panel extended, her free arm aloft and head tilting. Her raised arm lowers and the fan descends at her right side, the blue panel sweeping around toward her left. The fan rests low at her side as she steps wider and extends both arms outward.
